source: refactor dashboard metrics and build Figma Claims page

assumptions.text: No dedicated Compass KPI primitive exists, so the designer confirmed Card plus Chart plus Item for dashboard metrics
Quick Actions use Card plus ItemGroup and Item rows with Compass Buttons
Claims uses Card, Alert, InputGroup, Calendar with Popover, Select, DropdownMenu, Table, Badge, Button, and Pagination compositions
The Figma black Generate Report action maps to Compass primary Button because Compass has no black action variant
Figma status colors map to governed Badge semantics: Approved default, Rejected destructive, and Processing or Under Review outline
Figma 48px actions map to Compass large Button sizing, and the existing dashboard header and sidebar remain the shared shell
Search, dates, type, and sorting operate on local Figma-derived claim data; report and detail actions have no backend workflow
asset: Metric and report document icons use the exact exported Figma SVGs stored locally
